topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I can't understand why they'd do this, just when we’re finding our rhythm, our space here. It’s like they’re trying to tame the sky, draw borders in the breeze. This place, it needs to breathe, the way we do, without the weight of lines and stakes. How will the shadows play on the fence? Will it cast its doubts in patterns, remind us of what's confined? There's a way to speak without speaking, a way to keep the air between us open, but now? The whispers might stop, and the grass won’t run wild to their side anymore. I wish they could see, this isn’t just about the land—it’s about the freedom that spills over, the shared silence of the morning dew.
